title: LightVanillaPlus
description: Mostly Vanilla Minecraft with performance and QOL mods
body:
**LightVanillaPlus** is a lightweight **Quality of Life** modpack which enhances your vanilla experience while playing.

**Features include:**
- Performance Mods
- Villager trading additions
- Pre-installed shaders
- Ingame voice chat

Perfectly usable for private servers with friends or creative building in singleplayer.
